admin.description: Two teams, red and blue, race to find their words on a 5×5 board. Each team’s spymaster gives one-word clues; the agents guess. The board replaces the presentation for everyone, and each person can switch back.
admin.statusHost: A game is open and you are its host.
admin.statusOther: A game is open, hosted by {0}.
admin.hostAway: The host left the meeting, so the game is paused. Taking over ends the current match and keeps the teams.
admin.takeOverHint: You become the host: the current match ends (its key map stays with the previous host) and a new lobby opens with the same teams.

votes.howTo: Click the cards you think match the clue; click again to take the vote back. "Guess" reveals the card on top: the most voted, or on a tie the one voted first.
votes.rule: The agents vote for cards. When one of them presses "Guess", the card on top is revealed.

lobby.intro: A moderator draws the teams among everyone in the meeting. Then, in each team, someone offers to be the spymaster, who gives the clues. Everyone else is an agent and guesses.
lobby.hostNote: You are the host: your browser runs the game and receives the key map. If you are drawn as an agent, the board hides it from you.
